supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends significantly lateral to the outer ocular canthi, forming a wide 2D horizontal boundary.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle and mental regions exhibit significantly higher pixel intensity (lighter) compared to the dark, high-melanin periocular and malar regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: The lower lip exhibits moderate vertical thickness with a perceptible structural droop and a central parting.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent and dense white-grey hair across the chin and lower muzzle area.
